Background

The story so far

I started my career at KPMG as a Certified Public Accountant — learning to see every business through the lens of numbers, risk, and consequence. That rigor shapes everything I build.

I pivoted into tech and product, bringing something most PMs don't have: genuine financial depth. I've shipped across proptech at Bowery Valuation, programmatic advertising at FreeWheel (Comcast), healthcare ad tech at IQVIA, and currently drive data and interoperability product strategy at Northwell Health — New York's largest health system.

Now I'm exploring AI, LLMs, and agents — building tools that make complex things simple, and documenting what I learn along the way. This portfolio is both a resume and a live experiment.

Revamping the creatives module — core to campaign activation

The creatives module is the heartbeat of campaign activation. I led a full overhaul: Angular to Vue migration, bulk edit & upload, creative previews, additional media type support, major performance improvements, and in-app rejection reasons so users never had to chase answers in external DSPs.

AdTech · FreeWheel

Real-time collaboration for media traders — solving silent data loss

Media traders were silently overwriting each other's work inside shared media schedules and had no idea until hours of changes vanished. I led discovery, scoped the solution, and drove delivery of a real-time presence layer using SignalR — Google Docs-style awareness built for programmatic ad scheduling.

      My AI journey

      I'm a PM learning AI and LLMs from first principles — building, shipping, and documenting honestly. This page is a living log.

      Jun 2025
      Shipped

      Built & deployed the Financial Decision Analyzer

      My first AI-powered tool — designed the UX, engineered the prompts, and deployed it live via Netlify. Key lesson: prompt structure matters as much as the model. Got hands-on with system prompts, JSON output formatting, and API integration starting from near zero.

      Prompt engineering Claude API System prompts JSON outputs Netlify deploy
      Exploring now
      Learning

      Agents, memory & multi-step reasoning

      Next frontier: tools that can take multiple steps, hold context across a session, and act — not just respond to a single prompt. Interested in how agentic AI changes the PM role itself and what a product roadmap for an autonomous agent actually looks like.
